aliases: Incline chest press machine; Iso-lateral incline press (selectorised)

signature_exercises: Incline machine press; Single-arm incline machine press

name: Plate-loaded chest press

adjustability: Seat height adjust; independent arms.

signature_exercises: Seated back extension; Machine lower-back extension

signature_exercises: Chest-supported T-bar row; Wide-grip supported T-bar row

name: D.Y. row machine
aliases: Iso-lateral D.Y. row; Dorian Yates row machine

adjustability: Seat and chest pad adjust.
signature_exercises: Iso-lateral D.Y. row; Single-arm D.Y. row
buying_tips: Specialist piece; mostly found in Hammer Strength-equipped gyms.

name: High row machine
aliases: Iso-lateral high row; Plate-loaded high row
description: Seated machine pulling handles down and back from above, between a pulldown and a row, usually plate loaded with independent arms.

adjustability: Seat height and thigh pad adjust.
signature_exercises: Iso-lateral high row; Single-arm high row

safety: Lock your thighs under the pad before loading heavy.

name: Low row machine
aliases: Iso-lateral low row; Plate-loaded low row
description: Seated machine with handles pulled from low in front toward the hips, emphasising the lats.
adjustability: Seat height and chest pad adjust.
signature_exercises: Iso-lateral low row; Single-arm low row
buying_tips: Check the chest pad stops you from leaning back to cheat.
safety: Keep the spine neutral on the stretch.

name: Shrug machine
aliases: Plate-loaded shrug; Standing shrug machine; Seated shrug machine; Shrug / calf combo
description: Dedicated machine with handles or shoulder pads for heavy trap shrugs, often plate loaded and doubling as a standing calf raise.
weight_options: Holds ~200 kg+ of plates or ~150 kg stack
adjustability: Handle height or pad height adjust.
signature_exercises: Machine shrug; Single-arm machine shrug
buying_tips: A trap bar does the same job if space is tight.
safety: Keep the neck neutral; don't roll the shoulders.

name: Shoulder press machine
aliases: Machine overhead press; Seated shoulder press; Selectorised shoulder press
description: Seated machine pressing handles overhead on a guided path; selectorised in most gyms, plate-loaded and home-multi versions exist.
adjustability: Seat height adjust; neutral and wide grips.
signature_exercises: Machine shoulder press; Single-arm machine press
buying_tips: Look for a seat that adjusts low enough for tall users to get a full range.
safety: Don't arch the low back off the pad.

name: Lateral raise machine
aliases: Side raise machine; Deltoid raise machine; Standing lateral raise machine
description: Seated or standing machine where pads on the upper arms lift sideways to isolate the side delts.
adjustability: Seat height adjust; some have handle arms.
signature_exercises: Machine lateral raise; Single-arm machine lateral raise

aliases: Reverse pec deck; Rear delt fly machine; Reverse fly machine

adjustability: Seat height and arm start position adjust.
signature_exercises: Rear delt machine fly; Single-arm reverse pec deck

safety: Keep a slight elbow bend and don't shrug.

signature_exercises: EZ-bar curl; Skull crusher; Preacher curl; Reverse curl; Upright row

name: Leg extension machine
aliases: Quad extension machine; Plate-loaded leg extension; Iso-lateral leg extension
description: Seated machine with a shin pad you kick up to straighten the knees, isolating the quads.

description: Machine where you lie face down and curl a pad toward your glutes to train the hamstrings.
adjustability: Ankle pad and range adjust.
signature_exercises: Lying leg curl; Single-leg lying leg curl
buying_tips: Angled benches (hips higher) feel better than flat ones.
safety: Keep hips down on the pad.

name: Seated leg curl machine
aliases: Seated hamstring curl
description: Seated machine with a thigh hold-down where you pull a pad down and back to curl the knees; trains hamstrings in a lengthened position.
adjustability: Back pad, thigh pad and ankle pad adjust.
signature_exercises: Seated leg curl; Single-leg seated leg curl
buying_tips: Many coaches prefer it to the lying curl for hamstring growth.
safety: Lock the thigh pad down firmly before starting.

name: Standing calf raise machine
aliases: Standing calf machine; Shoulder-pad calf raise; Plate-loaded standing calf
description: Machine with shoulder pads and a toe block for standing calf raises with heavy load.
adjustability: Shoulder pad height adjust.
signature_exercises: Standing calf raise; Single-leg calf raise
buying_tips: A leg press or Smith machine with a block covers most needs.
safety: Don't bounce out of the bottom stretch.

name: Seated calf raise machine
aliases: Seated calf machine; Plate-loaded seated calf
description: Seated machine with a knee pad pressing down on the thighs, training the soleus with bent-knee calf raises; usually plate loaded.
adjustability: Knee pad height adjust.
signature_exercises: Seated calf raise; Single-leg seated calf raise
buying_tips: Compact home versions exist and are inexpensive.
safety: Release the safety lever slowly.

name: Hip thrust machine
aliases: Glute drive; Booty builder; Plate-loaded hip thrust; Glute bridge machine
description: Machine with a back pad and belt or lever pad over the hips so you can hip-thrust heavy without rolling a barbell on.
adjustability: Back pad height and belt adjust.
signature_exercises: Machine hip thrust; Single-leg machine hip thrust
buying_tips: Look for quick in-and-out; belt systems are faster than barbell setups.
safety: Keep the chin tucked and stop at full hip extension.

name: Glute kickback machine
aliases: Glute kickback machine; Plate-loaded kickback; Donkey kick machine
description: Kneeling or standing machine where you push one leg back against a foot plate or pad to train glute hip extension.
adjustability: Chest pad and foot plate adjust.
signature_exercises: Glute kickback machine; Single-leg kickback
buying_tips: A cable with an ankle strap is a cheaper alternative.
safety: Don't arch the lower back to finish.

description: Seated machine with leg pads you push apart (abduction) or squeeze together (adduction) to train the outer glutes and inner thighs.

signature_exercises: Hip abduction machine; Hip adduction machine; Leaning hip abduction

name: Captain's chair / knee raise station

description: An upright frame with a back pad and elbow pads where you support yourself on the forearms and raise your knees or legs.

name: Ab crunch machine

description: Seated machine with chest pads or handles you curl forward against a stack, loading the abs through a crunch.
adjustability: Seat height adjust.
signature_exercises: Machine crunch; Weighted ab crunch
buying_tips: Pick one where your hips stay put and only the spine flexes.
safety: Exhale and curl; don't pull with the arms.

name: Rotary torso machine
aliases: Torso rotation machine; Oblique machine; Rotary torso
description: Seated machine where you twist the upper body against a stack to train the obliques.
adjustability: Start rotation angle adjust.
signature_exercises: Rotary torso; Seated twist
buying_tips: Cable woodchops and Pallof presses cover much of this.
safety: Rotate slowly through a comfortable range.

name: Medicine ball

description: A weighted ball for throws, passes, twists and loaded core work; rubber ones bounce back off walls and the floor.
